"Seven" is the fourth episode of the first season of the American fantasy drama television series A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms. Directed by Sarah Adina Smith and written by Aziza Barnes, Annie Julia Wyman and series co-creator Ira Parker, it aired on HBO on February 8, 2026.
The episode was filmed in Belfast in 2024.
